capabilities: Convert selected URLs into provider-specific iframe embeds with a live preview and aspect-ratio picker
Embed content from 30+ providers including YouTube, Spotify, Reddit, Twitter/X and Google services
Download image, Google Docs, and Quizlet assets to the vault alongside the embed
Export Quizlet flashcard sets to Markdown notes, single-file or one note per card
Migrate legacy ![](url) embeds to the current HTML format
extras: Generated embeds are plain HTML that keep rendering even if the plugin is disabled or removed; Google Docs and Quizlet exports require publicly shared content, and Spotify embeds are limited to 30-second previews.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn pasted URLs into provider-specific rich embeds inside notes.

relations.evidence: Built on GnoxNahte's obsidian-auto-embed, which was itself inspired by Sam Warnick's archived Simple Embed.
New architecture and provider class system draws from FHachez's obsidian-convert-url-to-iframe.
Save-to-vault concepts inspired by Seraphli's obsidian-link-embed.
Recommended for use with the Yanki plugin, which syncs Obsidian notes to Anki.

summary: Converts selected URLs into iframe embeds via a live-preview modal, supporting 30+ providers with optional save-to-vault actions.
